stories.title: Aave proposal could cut some lenders' interest share by 60%
stories.summary: Aave is weighing a proposal that could cut some lenders' share of interest by as much as 60%, CryptoSlate reports. The report does not name the affected pools or lenders. The mechanism and timeline are not yet clear from the single report available.
stories.whyItMatters: Changes to Aave's interest split affect returns for lenders on one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
whatToWatch: Whether the proposal reaches a formal governance vote
Which lender pools the change would affect
Reaction from lenders who stand to lose yield
questions: Which lenders would see lower returns?
What problem is the proposal meant to solve?

stories.title: Bitcoin falls below $70,000 as $870M in bullish bets are liquidated
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 and set off about $870 million in liquidations of bullish positions, CryptoSlate reports. The cost to hedge against a further drop near that level more than doubled in a single day. CryptoSlate also reports that the large pool of open futures positions now has less fresh cash behind it, which could limit a quick rebound.
stories.whyItMatters: Fast leveraged unwinds plus thin futures liquidity raise the odds of sharp price swings in either direction.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitcoin holds support near $70,000
Funding rates and open interest over the next few days
Options prices for further downside hedges
questions: What triggered the initial drop below $70,000?
How much leveraged positioning is still at risk of liquidation?

Bitcoin’s futures pile has a problem: less cash to fuel a rebound

stories.title: Amazon: no human wrote or reviewed code for its new cloud testing tool
stories.summary: Amazon says a new cloud testing tool it released had no human author or reviewer; AI wrote and checked the code instead, CryptoSlate reports. The report does not describe the tool's scope or what testing happened before release. It stands as one of the clearest public claims yet of fully AI-built production code.
stories.whyItMatters: Crypto infrastructure runs heavily on cloud platforms, so unreviewed AI-written code at a major provider raises supply-chain risk questions for the sector.
whatToWatch: Whether other cloud providers make similar disclosures
Any bugs or security issues tied to the tool
Amazon's stated review process going forward
questions: What testing, if any, happened before release?
Does 'no human reviewed' rule out all human oversight, not just code review?

sources.title: Amazon says no human wrote or reviewed the code for its new cloud testing tool

stories.title: Lido Earn's new safety net still leaves depositors on the hook for losses
stories.summary: Lido added a new safety mechanism to its Earn product, but depositors still carry loss risk despite it, CryptoSlate reports. The report does not give the size of the buffer or which scenarios it covers. How much risk the new net actually removes is unclear from the single report available.
stories.whyItMatters: Lido is one of the largest liquid-staking protocols, so its handling of depositor risk sets a reference point for safety claims across DeFi yield products.
whatToWatch: Published details on the safety net's coverage limits
Any depositor losses that test the mechanism
Auditor or community response to the design
questions: How does the new net compare with Lido's prior protections?

sources.title: Lido Earn’s new safety net still leaves depositors on the hook for losses

stories.title: US report: Japan's yen intervention used euros, not dollars
stories.summary: A new US report found that Japan's recent intervention to support the yen used euros rather than dollars, CryptoSlate reports. CryptoSlate links this detail to Bitcoin but does not explain the mechanism in detail. No figures on the size of the intervention appear in the available source.
stories.whyItMatters: Currency interventions shape global liquidity and risk appetite, a backdrop traders watch when they price Bitcoin.
whatToWatch: Further detail from the US report on intervention mechanics
Yen and dollar moves in response
Follow-on commentary on the link to Bitcoin
questions: Why would euros rather than dollars change the read for Bitcoin?
What is the source and scope of this US report?

stories.title: XRP loans trigger 883 liquidations, $53M more at risk
stories.summary: A wave of XRP-collateralized loans triggered 883 liquidations, CryptoSlate reports. About $53 million in additional positions remain at risk. The report does not name the lending platform or the price move that set this off.
stories.whyItMatters: A liquidation cascade in XRP lending shows how concentrated leverage in one token can amplify price swings for borrowers and the wider market.
whatToWatch: Whether XRP's price stabilizes enough to avoid further forced liquidations
The $53 million in positions still flagged at risk
Any platform response or change to risk parameters
questions: What price move triggered the initial liquidations?

stories.title: FBI warns of $400M crypto scam using deepfake face-swap videos
stories.summary: The FBI warned of an active crypto scam already tied to about $400 million in losses, CryptoSlate reports. The scam uses deepfake video to swap in a familiar face, often a friend's, to build trust before victims send crypto. The report does not name the platforms where the scam spreads.
stories.whyItMatters: Deepfake scams that impersonate a trusted contact mark an escalation in crypto fraud tactics, with real losses already large.
whatToWatch: Further FBI guidance or takedown action
Whether platforms add detection tools for face-swap videos
Updated loss figures as investigations continue
questions: How do victims first get contacted?
Which crypto assets or platforms carry the scam's payouts?

sources.title: FBI warns active $400M crypto scam targets your friends by replacing your face in videos

stories.title: Crypto's rush into Anthropic's IPO comes with a lockup catch
stories.summary: Crypto investors are moving quickly to get exposure ahead of an expected Anthropic IPO, but CryptoSlate reports a catch: money locked into pre-IPO vehicles carries no guarantee of an eventual allocation. The report frames this as a risk for investors who seek access through crypto-linked structures. The available source gives no figures on lockup length or amounts raised.
stories.whyItMatters: Pre-IPO access vehicles tied to high-profile AI companies are pulling in crypto capital, so their terms and risks matter to anyone weighing in.
whatToWatch: Timing of any Anthropic IPO announcement
Terms disclosed by specific pre-IPO vehicles marketed to crypto investors
Regulatory scrutiny of these access structures
questions: Which vehicles or platforms offer this exposure?
What are the actual lockup terms and allocation odds?

sources.title: The catch in crypto’s Anthropic IPO rush: lock up your money and you could still miss out
